Little Buckets Farm Sanctuary is a nonprofit registered 501(c)(3) animal rescue, striving to give as many animals a safe and loving home they all so deserve. We offer a forever sanctuary to horses, goats, cows, donkeys, pigs, dogs, and cats who all need a place to call home. 
In 2017, I created a bucket list to save a life at a livestock auction and that life was a little baby calf who I named Bucket. He is now 8 years old, best friends with my dog, Colton and his pal, Bailey who was also saved in 2017. Saving Bucket's life inspired me to move to a new state to start this sanctuary. We hope you decide to follow Little Buckets gang. I promise you will laugh, smile, and love a lot, and sometimes cry.  
All donations are tax-deductible and help with the daily care, hay, and feed of all the animals as well as allow us to save more lives. We want as many precious souls to have a happy, long life here at Little Buckets. We hope you see our gang is no different than your dog or cat.
